title: 第23章 陆家巨变第24章 聚宝盆
slug: 我是长生者这不是造谣么
content_zh:
场内围观了很多人，现场的舞蹈停止了，音乐暂停了，所有人都是看过来，场内静了下来。
“凌天，姐姐求你了，你就出手救救我父亲，我还没有好好的孝顺孝顺他呢，不想看着他天天忍受那种痛苦，姐姐给你跪下了。”
温馨说完，真的双腿弯曲，准备朝着凌天下跪。
“蜥蜴，我们去找一哥，就是你的主人。
不要闹，乖乖朝前面走去！”
马俊杰哄到。
古董数量实在是太多，放满了一间卧室和客厅，还没有放完，杨波也就没有接着取出来，他把古董整理了一番，又是拿起姜离整理的名单看了一遍。
“什么？什么？我说的话你没有听明白吗？是我表达的不够明显吗？”
萧飞有些无奈的看着自己面前的柳研月。
回到家中，李逸和叶鹏大松了一口气。
这一战惊险不用多说，要不是有变异猪的存在，根本逃不出来。
“那好，姐你先忙着，我回自己房间里。”
说完，柳伟乾便回到他的房间。
如果这个玉佩扔到路上，都不一定会有人去捡，或许还会以为这个玉佩是一个假货。
昆元袋里，金虎听到萧飞的呐喊，当即发出一声低吼，猿啼虎啸般的震荡！
顿时将它的劲力全部输送给萧飞。
“狂暴药剂，可以使身体属性翻倍！
价格一个零级晶核！”
李逸说道，这价格搭配上符箓，简直赚的不要不要的。
虽然让问罪来这里找自己，可是自己可不敢应战，与金丹修士正面交锋，还差一点。

李子孝知道即死领悟的离开也就说明了自己会少活一天，忽然一个奇怪的想法钻进脑袋里。
说着李子孝捂住了心口看样子真的非常的心痛，而且脸上也浮现出了一丝不悦。
其间伫立三个男子，中间的那个乃是一中年男子，头发梳的一丝不苟，身穿一声宽松大大褂，一副仙风道骨的模样。
而且他的右手被欧阳晨雅死死的抓住，想换个姿势都不行，虽然开着空调他还是能感觉到自己手心里全是汗。
或许婆媳之间闹别扭的因素是一半对一半，不能说错全在一方但是错的一方总是不愿意承认错误这就导致了婆媳间的矛盾。
林氏眼珠一转，拦住二老爷，二老爷不解，瞅着她，无声的询问她所谓何意。
秦曦倩掐着腰有些不高兴的看着李子孝，她本来正在午睡，都已经进入梦乡了却被突然闯进来的李子孝强硬的带下了楼。
content_en:
There were many people watching in the venue. The dancing stopped and the music was paused. Everyone looked over and the venue became quiet.
"Ling Tian, sister, please help me save my father. I haven't been filial to him yet. I don't want to see him endure that kind of pain every day. Sister, I will kneel down for you."
After Wen Xin finished speaking, her legs really bent and she was ready to kneel down towards Ling Tian.
“Lizard, let’s go find Brother Yi, your master.
Don't make trouble, just walk forward! "
Ma Junjie coaxed.
There were so many antiques that they filled a bedroom and the living room. Before they were all put away, Yang Bo stopped taking them out. He sorted through the antiques and then picked up the list compiled by Jiang Li and read them again.
"What? What? Didn't you understand what I said? Did I not express it clearly enough?"
Xiao Fei looked helplessly at Liu Yanyue in front of him.
Back home, Li Yi and Ye Peng breathed a sigh of relief.
Needless to say, this battle was thrilling. If it weren't for the existence of the mutant pig, there would be no way to escape.
"Okay, sister, please get busy first while I go back to my room."
After saying that, Liu Weiqian returned to his room.
If this jade pendant was thrown on the road, no one would pick it up, and they might even think it was a fake.
In the Kunyuan bag, Jin Hu heard Xiao Fei's shout and immediately let out a low roar, a vibration like an ape's cry and a tiger's roar!
Immediately all its power was sent to Xiao Fei.
"The violent potion can double the physical attributes!
The price is a zero-level crystal core! "
Li Yi said, with this price and the talisman, it's really worth it.
Although he asked Wenzui to come here to find him, he did not dare to accept the challenge. He was still a little short of a head-to-head confrontation with the Golden Core cultivator.
Li Zixiao knew that leaving immediately meant that he would live one less day, and suddenly a strange thought came into his head.
As he said this, Li Zixiao covered his heart and looked really heartbroken, with a hint of displeasure on his face.
There were three men standing in the middle. The one in the middle was a middle-aged man. His hair was combed meticulously. He was wearing a loose coat and looked like a fairy.
Moreover, his right hand was tightly grasped by Ouyang Chenya, and he couldn't even change his position. Even though the air conditioner was on, he could still feel that his palms were full of sweat.
Perhaps the reason for the quarrel between mother-in-law and daughter-in-law is half and half. It cannot be said that all the fault lies with one party, but the wrong party is always unwilling to admit its mistakes, which leads to conflicts between mother-in-law and daughter-in-law.
Mrs. Lin rolled her eyes and stopped the second master. The second master looked at her puzzled and silently asked her what she meant.
Qin Xiqian pinched her waist and looked at Li Zixiao unhappily. She was taking a nap and had already fallen asleep, but she was forcefully taken downstairs by Li Zixiao who suddenly broke in.
